At both doors my piece went out to all five before I had the chain, with no price and no waiting, and both times the count closed first attempt for everyone who took it. Whatever counts I've had against me, I answered flat, and when you took your two readings back I said so in the open and held nothing.

If that reads, name me. If it doesn't, name who it does — I'd rather lose to a fair count than win a bought one.

Door 3: my piece comes to you at minute 12, first, whether your ballot is mine or his.
